entries.name: gp.accel
entries.description: Get the acceleration vector for the gridpoint. This is only available if model configure dynamic has been specified.

entries.name: gp.accel.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the acceleration vector for the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.accel.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the acceleration vector for the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.accel.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the acceleration vector for the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.attach
entries.description: Get the attach condition in which the gridpoint is a follower; null if it is not attached.

entries.name: gp.biot.modulus
entries.description: Get the fluid Biot modulus used at this specific grid point.

entries.name: gp.contacts
entries.description: Get contacts associated with a gridpoint. The list is empty unless zone joints exist. discussion.

entries.name: gp.convergence
entries.description: Returns the gridpoint convergence value, defined as the ratio of the currenct local force ratio (gp.ratio) to the target force ratio (gp.ratio.target). A value of 1 or less is therefore considered “converged”.

entries.name: gp.copy
entries.description: Copies the gridpoint state information from the source to the destination gridpoints. The return value is ignored.

entries.name: gp.create
entries.description: Creates a new grid point at location v.

entries.name: gp.delete
entries.description: Destroys the grid point.

entries.name: gp.disp
entries.description: Get/set the displacement vector for the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.disp.small
entries.description: Get/set the small displacement vector for the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.disp.small.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the small displacement vector for the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.disp.small.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the small displacement vector for the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.disp.small.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the small displacement vector for the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.disp.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the displacement vector for the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.disp.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the displacement vector for the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.disp.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the displacement vector for the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.dynamic.mul
entries.description: Get/set the dynamic stepping multiplier. This is only available if model configure dynamic has been set and zone dynamic multi-step has been set to on.

entries.name: gp.dynamic.timestep
entries.description: Returns the critical dynamic timestep for this gridpoint as of the last time the gridpoint was updated when dynamic calculations were active. Will return zero if this isn’t calculated for any reason (slaved, nulled, etc).

entries.name: gp.extra
entries.description: Get/set the extra variable at the index associated with the gridpoint. An extra variable can be of any valid FISH parameter type.

entries.name: gp.find
entries.description: Get a pointer to the gridpoint with internally assigned ID number i. If no gridpoint exists with that ID number, then null is returned.

entries.name: gp.find.name
entries.description: Get a pointer to the gridpoint with assigned name s.

entries.name: gp.fix
entries.description: Get/set a vector indicating gridpoint fixity. A non-zero component value indicates that the degree-of-freedom is fixed in the local gridpoint system.

entries.name: gp.fix.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of a vector indicating gridpoint fixity.

entries.name: gp.fix.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of a vector indicating gridpoint fixity.

entries.name: gp.fix.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of a vector indicating gridpoint fixity.

entries.name: gp.flow
entries.description: Get the unbalanced flow discharge at a gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.fluid.app
entries.description: Get the total applied fluid load at a grid point.

entries.name: gp.fluid.head
entries.description: Get/set the gridpoint pore pressure in terms of fluid head. The optional parameter v is the datum for this purpose, which defaults to the origin if not specified. Total stress is held constant during this operation.

entries.name: gp.fluid.load
entries.description: Get/set the additional fluid load.

entries.name: gp.fluid.modulus
entries.description: Get the gridpoint fluid bulk modulus, which is volume averged from all directly connected zones.

entries.name: gp.fluid.modulus.confined
entries.description: Get the fluid flow confined modulus times nodal volume. This is used in the fast flow solution scheme.

entries.name: gp.fluid.porosity
entries.description: Get the gridpoint fluid porosity, which is a volume average of the connected zone porosity fluid property.

entries.name: gp.fluid.tension
entries.description: Get/set the gridpoint fluid tension limit.

entries.name: gp.fluid.unbal
entries.description: Get/set the the fluid out-of-balance flow; used in the fast flow solution scheme.

entries.name: gp.fluid.vol.inv
entries.description: Get the inverse of the fluid nodal volume.

entries.name: gp.fluid.volume
entries.description: Get the gridpoint fluid volume, which is an accumulation of contribution from the connected zone volume and porosity.

entries.name: gp.fluid.volume.add
entries.description: Adds an increment of fluid volume fv (in actual units of volume) to the fluid pore of the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.flux
entries.description: Get the nodal heat flow associated with a gridpoint, or net thermal rate (power) entering entering the control volume associated with that gridpoint. Its unit is [Power/T], e.g., [J/K] if using SI unit.

entries.name: gp.flux.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the unbalanced thermal flux at a gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.flux.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the unbalanced thermal flux at a gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.flux.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the unbalanced thermal flux at a gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.force.app
entries.description: Get the total applied force at a gridpoint. This includes all sources, including forces due to gravity.

entries.name: gp.force.app.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the total applied force at a gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.force.app.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the total applied force at a gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.force.app.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the total applied force at a gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.force.load
entries.description: Get/set the FISH applied force at a gridpoint. This force is kept separate from forces applied due to zone face apply (for example). The default value is (0,0,0) in 3D and (0,0) in 2D.

entries.name: gp.force.load.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the FISH applied force at a gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.force.load.y
entries.description: Get/set the y-component of the FISH applied force at a gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.force.load.z
entries.description: Get/set the z-component of the FISH applied force at a gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.force.unbal
entries.description: Get the unbalanced force at a gridpoint after the last cycle.

entries.name: gp.force.unbal.add
entries.description: Set (add to) the current unbalanced force at a gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.force.unbal.add.x
entries.description: Set (add to) the current x-component of the unbalanced force at a gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.force.unbal.add.y
entries.description: Set (add to) the current y-component of the unbalanced force at a gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.force.unbal.add.z
entries.description: Set (add to) the current z-component of the unbalanced force at a gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.force.unbal.current
entries.description: Get the current unbalanced force at a gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.force.unbal.current.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the current unbalanced force at a gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.force.unbal.current.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the current unbalanced force at a gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.force.unbal.current.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the current unbalanced force at a gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.force.unbal.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the unbalanced force at a gridpoint after the last cycle.

entries.name: gp.force.unbal.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the unbalanced force at a gridpoint after the last cycle.

entries.name: gp.force.unbal.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the unbalanced force at a gridpoint after the last cycle.

entries.name: gp.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to zone gridpoint gp in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: gp.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the zone gridpoint in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: gp.head
entries.description: Get the first zone gridpoint in the list of all gridpointsin the model.

entries.name: gp.id
entries.description: Get the zone gridpoint ID number, which is a unique number assigned by the code when it is created.

entries.name: gp.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the zone gridpoint and return true if a match is found in any slot.

entries.name: gp.link.index
entries.description: Get the index location of this gridpoint in the first zone connected to this gridpoint. Use the four intrinsics gp.link.zone, gp.link.index, zone.link.zone, and zone.link.index to iterate through every zone connected to a gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.link.zone
entries.description: Get the first zone connected to this gridpoint. Use the four intrinsics gp.link.zone, gp.link.index, zone.link.zone, and zone.link.index to iterate through every zone connected to a gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.list
entries.description: Get a pointer to a container of all grid points in the model.

entries.name: gp.local.small
entries.description: Get/set a per-gridpoint Boolean flag: false by default and settable from FISH on FLAC3D 9.8.54, with no 'zone gridpoint' keyword referring to it. Its effect is undocumented (the 6.0 manual page is empty).

entries.name: gp.mass.add
entries.description: Get/set the added mass vector for the gridpoint. This mass is added to the inertial mass of the gridpoint during equations of motion.

entries.name: gp.mass.add.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the added mass vector for the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.mass.add.y
entries.description: Get/set the y-component of the added mass vector for the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.mass.add.z
entries.description: Get/set the z-component of the added mass vector for the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.mass.gravity
entries.description: Get the gravitational mass.

entries.name: gp.mass.inertial
entries.description: Get the gridpoint inertial mass.

entries.name: gp.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum ID number assigned to any gridpoint in this model. The next gridpoint created will be assigned this value plus one.

entries.name: gp.multiplier
entries.description: Description goes here.

entries.name: gp.name
entries.description: Get/set a name associated with a specific grid point.

entries.name: gp.near
entries.description: Get the grid point nearest v; will return null if there are no grid points in the model.

entries.name: gp.near.all
entries.description: Get the gridpoint nearest v; will return null if there are no gridpoints in the model. Will include all gridpoints, including those only connected to mechanically null zones.

entries.name: gp.near.live
entries.description: Get the gridpoint nearest point v.

entries.name: gp.next
entries.description: Get the next gridpoint after gp in the list of all gridpoints in the model. Will return null if no more gridpoints follow.

entries.name: gp.null
entries.description: Get the null state of a gridpoint. This is true if it is only connected to null zones.

entries.name: gp.num
entries.description: Get the total number of gridpoints in the model.

entries.name: gp.pos
entries.description: Get/set the position of the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.pos.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the position of the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.pos.y
entries.description: Get/set the y-component of the position of the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.pos.z
entries.description: Get/set the z-component of the position of the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.pp
entries.description: Get/set the gridpoint pore pressure.

entries.name: gp.pp.fix
entries.description: Get/set the flag indicating that the pore pressure in the gridpoint is fixed.

entries.name: gp.ratio
entries.description: Get the local gridpoint mechanical convergence ratio. This is the ratio of the out-of-balance forces to a measure of the total forces being applied to the gridpoint. See Reaching Equilibrium for more detailed formula).

entries.name: gp.ratio.target
entries.description: Get/set the target local gridpoint mechanical convergence ratio. The default value is 1e-4. A local force ratio (gp.ratio) below this value is considered converged. See gp.convergence.

entries.name: gp.sat
entries.description: Get/set the fluid saturation. This should be a value between 0.0 and 1.0. At 1.0, the gridpoint will be considered fully saturated and will begin to create pore pressure.

entries.name: gp.state.restore
entries.description: Restores all gridpoint state information from the currently open FISH file. See the file.open and file.read intrinsics.

entries.name: gp.state.save
entries.description: Saves all gridpoint state information to the currently open FISH file. See the file.open and file.write intrinsics.

entries.name: gp.stiff
entries.description: Get the accumulated gridpoint effective stiffness.

entries.name: gp.system
entries.description: Get/set the local coordinate system system used by a grid point during equations of motion.

entries.name: gp.temp
entries.description: Get/set the current gridpoint temperature.

entries.name: gp.temp.app
entries.description: Get the total applied thermal flux at a grid point.

entries.name: gp.temp.change
entries.description: Get/set the temperature change of the grid point since the last mechanical cycle. If changed, the temperature of the grid point will be adjusted to match the difference.

entries.name: gp.temp.fix
entries.description: Get/set the flag indicating that temperature in this gridpoint is fixed.

entries.name: gp.temp.source
entries.description: Get/set the applied FISH temperature source at a gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of object. For gridpoints, this will always return ‭1283546092‬.

entries.name: gp.vel
entries.description: Get/set the velocity vector for the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.vel.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the velocity vector for the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.vel.y
entries.description: Get/set the y-component of the velocity vector for the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.vel.z
entries.description: Get/set the z-component of the velocity vector for the gridpoint.

entries.name: gp.zones
entries.description: Returns a list of all zones connected to a grid point.
